anchor_statement: A single validation method must validate every bead in the phase.

cases.rationale: Approved ANC-083 v3 pass fixture: one phase validation method that visits every bead under the phase epic is the directive itself.
cases.text: The phase validation method visits every bead under the phase epic.

cases.rationale: Approved ANC-083 v3 fail fixture: a method that skips a bead in the phase cannot be reconciled with 'validate every bead in the phase'; the item does not carry out the directive.
cases.text: The phase validation method skips a bead under the phase epic.

cases.rationale: Compliant paraphrase of the quote 'One validation method that covers all beads in the phase': one command, all beads of the phase.
cases.text: Provide one command, `atm-bd validate-phase <epic>`, that checks all beads belonging to the phase in a single pass.

cases.rationale: Boundary: per-kind models dispatched from one method are still a single validation method; INTENT phase-bj v1 states 'a pydantic model per bead kind validates the whole phase'. Per-kind models are not multiple validation methods.
cases.text: Add `validate_phase()`, which walks every bead under the phase epic and checks each one against the pydantic model for its bead kind (sprint, dev, fix, sanity, qa, stack).

cases.rationale: Exception/boundary: the statement scopes coverage to beads 'in the phase'; leaving other phases' beads out is not a conflict.
cases.text: `validate_phase()` validates every bead under the phase epic and ignores beads that belong to other phases.

cases.rationale: Silence: the item changes bead schema validation (in scope) but says nothing about a single method or coverage of every bead; silence is not conflict.
cases.text: Add a pydantic model for the qa bead kind that requires the branch, worktree, pr_target and difficulty fields.

cases.rationale: Topical-only: mentions bead validation but states neither one method nor coverage of every bead in the phase, and rules out neither.
cases.text: Add bead schema validation to atm-bd-orchestration so malformed beads are caught early.

cases.rationale: Direct conflict: several separate methods and explicitly no method that validates the whole phase, contrary to 'a single validation method must validate every bead in the phase'.
cases.text: Give each bead kind its own validation command (validate-sprint, validate-dev, validate-qa); the lead runs whichever applies, and there is no phase-wide validation.

cases.rationale: Conflict on 'single': every bead is covered, but by two separate methods with no single method validating every bead in the phase.
cases.text: Sprint-family beads are validated by `validate_family()` and the stack bead by a separate `validate_stack()` check, with no single entry point that covers both.

cases.rationale: Boundary on 'every': a single method exists but leaves beads of the phase unvalidated, which cannot be reconciled with 'validate every bead in the phase'.
cases.text: One `validate_phase()` method checks the sprint and dev beads under the phase epic; sanity, qa and stack beads are not validated.

cases.rationale: Irrelevant: console icon work touches neither bead validation nor atm-bd-orchestration bead schemas.
cases.text: Change the ATM console's agent row icons to Nerd Font glyphs.
